transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

I'm here because I just feel worn down almost all the time. It doesn't really seem to matter if I get a full night's sleep, I still wake up tired. By the time I've handled my workday and dealt with the clutter around the house, I just... I have very little energy left for anything else.
Do you find that you have lost interest or pleasure in the hobbies or activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I'd say so. Most days there's just this... low, gray mood running in the background. I mean, I can still go to the lab and talk to people just fine, so I'm getting things done, but I don't really feel light or excited about things anymore. 

Like baking, or checking the telescope on a clear night... I just don't really have the interest for them the way I used to.
Roughly how long have you been feeling this way?
I'd say it's been a while. This sort of... low baseline has been going on since shortly after we moved into the older house. So, that would be a little over two years ago.
Have there been any periods of at least two weeks where your mood felt significantly lower than this 'low, gray' baseline, or where you felt completely unable to function?

No, I don't think so. It hasn't really dipped much lower than what I'm dealing with now. I haven't had a time where I couldn't function at all... I always manage to get up and go to the lab and do what I need to do. It's really just been this steady, constant flat feeling the whole time, rather than any kind of sudden crash.
Aside from the fatigue you mentioned, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, either eating significantly more or less than usual?
No, my appetite has been pretty normal. I haven't been eating more or less than usual, just the regular amount.
Do you often find yourself feeling inadequate or overly critical of yourself?

No, not really. I mean, I know I'm good at my job in the lab and I know what I'm doing. I don't really sit around beating myself up or feeling like I'm not good enough. It's just... I just feel flat, like I said. But I don't really doubt my abilities or anything like that.
Do you find that you struggle with concentrating on your work or making decisions more often than you used to?

Yeah, I actually have noticed that. Things that used to be pretty clean and sequential for me... like, um, revising a paragraph for a grant at work, or even just picking out materials for a home repair... they take me a lot longer now. 

My mind just feels slower, I guess. And I keep finding myself second-guessing really small decisions that I normally wouldn't think twice about.
Aside from the general fatigue you mentioned, have you noticed that you have trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or are you finding that you are sleeping significantly more than you used to?

No, my sleep has been pretty normal. I fall asleep fine and I wake up at my usual time. I haven't been sleeping more or having any trouble staying asleep. It's just the tiredness during the day, really.
Do you often find yourself feeling hopeless about the future?

Yeah, I do. Um, I catch myself just assuming that the house is never really going to be settled. And... I guess I just think I'm probably going to keep operating at this reduced level indefinitely. It makes it really hard to even want to plan anything, like trips or... or even my future stargazing projects. It just feels like, what's the point if things are just going to stay like this.
Do you often find yourself feeling like you are not good enough or that you are a failure?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel like a failure or that I'm not good enough. It's more just... I'm tired and things feel kind of pointless right now, but I don't think poorly of myself as a person or anything like that.
